_note: Update by asking Claude in this workspace: 'refresh media/pricing.json from https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing'. Keys are the model id with the trailing -YYYYMMDD release date stripped (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 -> claude-sonnet-4-5). Lookup uses longest-prefix match against this table. cache_write_5m and cache_write_1h are the 5-minute and 1-hour ephemeral cache write rates respectively; pick whichever the model used per turn. cache_read is the cache-hit rate.
_caveats: Opus 4.5+ dropped Opus pricing from $15/$75 to $5/$25 (per-MTok input/output). Opus 4.1 and earlier kept the old $15/$75.

Opus 4.7 uses a new tokenizer that may consume up to 35% more tokens for the same text — this is a tokenization change, not a price change, but it makes Opus 4.7 effectively more expensive than the rate alone suggests.
Sonnet 3.7 and Opus 3 are deprecated but still listed for older log entries.
Sonnet 3 has no pricing row on the page (only appears in tool-use table); not included here.
